next_attempt_protocol.trigger: When one of the three ACCESS_BLOCKED sources becomes reachable (Wikisource 卷11 正文完成录入 / ctext 机构订阅 / 杨守敬水经注疏 644196 镜像可用)
next_attempt_protocol.step_1: Re-fetch the blocked URL with web_fetch (short timeout ≤ 12s)
next_attempt_protocol.step_2: Extract the specific phrases listed in records[].would_need_to_verify_passages[] using grep/regex over the extracted text
next_attempt_protocol.step_3: Compare against R4 frozen OCR primary_excerpt for each pid
next_attempt_protocol.step_4: Record CORROBORATES / VARIANT / CONTRADICTION / INCONCLUSIVE per pid per source
next_attempt_protocol.step_5: If VARIANT found (e.g., 攜徐盧 vs 撅徐盧), update yishui_claims_r4_2.json with claim_text_variant_observed
next_attempt_protocol.step_6: If CONTRADICTION found, do NOT raise evidence level — keep as PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED or downgrade per R34 spec §D '不得为了增加 SUPPORTED 数量而提高证据等级'
next_attempt_protocol.step_7: Do NOT interpret ancient textual geography as modern geographic fact (R34 spec §D explicit boundary)
